predictions.en_reason: Parma sacked Carlos Cuesta after the 3-0 loss at Inter and appointed Alberto Gilardino, so this is the new manager's first game — a possible bounce, but the squad is thin with Elphege (appendicitis surgery), Almqvist and Nicolussi Caviglia out, and they've conceded in all six league games. Torino are unbeaten in two (2-1 vs Udinese, 1-1 at Bologna), solid away (1W 1D 1L), won the last meeting 4-1 and have scored first in five of the last seven H2Hs. Expect a cagey, low-scoring game — both rank bottom-three for shots on target — with Torino's experience edging it. (Prediction only — nothing is certain.)

predictions.reason_mm: ကာလိယာရီဟာ ဒီရာသီ အဝေးကွင်း 3 ပွဲကစားပြီး 3 ပွဲလုံးနိုင်ထားတယ် (ပါးမား 1-0, အတ္တလန္တာ 2-1, အူဒီနီဇီ 1-0) — ပေးဂိုး 3 ဂိုးသာ၊ လိဂ်မှာ အနည်းဆုံး။ နောက် 4 ပွဲမှာ ရှုံးပွဲမရှိ (3 နိုင်ပွဲ 1 သရေ)၊ Daniel Maldini က 4 ပွဲဆက် ဂိုးသွင်းနေပါတယ်။ မွန်ဇာက 6 ပွဲမှာ 4 ပွဲရှုံး (ပေးဂိုး 15 ဂိုး)၊ Matteo Pessina ဒဏ်ရာရ၊ Lorenzo Lucchesi ပွဲပယ်ခံထားရ၊ H2H နောက် 4 ပွဲမှာ ကာလိယာရီ 2 ကြိမ်နိုင်။ ဂိုးနည်းနိုင်ခြေမြင့် — ကာလိယာရီ 6 ပွဲမှာ 5 ပွဲ under 2.5။
predictions.en_reason: Cagliari have won all three away games this season (Parma 1-0, Atalanta 2-1, Udinese 1-0) and conceded only three goals total — the fewest in Serie A. They are unbeaten in four (3 wins, 1 draw), and Daniel Maldini has scored in four consecutive matches. Monza have lost four of six, conceding 15 goals; Matteo Pessina is injured and Lorenzo Lucchesi is suspended. Head-to-head: Cagliari won two of the last four meetings. Expect a low-scoring game — five of Cagliari's six matches went under 2.5 goals.

Getafe are unbeaten at home this season (2W 2D, only 2 conceded at the Coliseum) but have the joint-worst attack in La Liga (4 goals in 8 games), a long injury list - Uche (cruciate), Juanmi (knee), Zaid Romero (quad) - and heavy legs after Thursday's Conference League trip to Romania (1-1 at Universitatea Craiova). Rayo are winless away (1D 3L, 12 conceded) yet carry the game's one genuine difference-maker in Sergio Camello (7 goals in 7 league apps), though first-choice keeper Batalla (broken leg) is a big miss. Getafe are winless in the last 10 meetings (Rayo 2W 3D in the last five) and nine straight H2Hs finished under 2.5 goals. Both sit on 8 points, one above the drop zone, so expect an edgy Madrid derby - 1-1 the most likely scoreline. Probabilities: Getafe 32%, draw 38%, Rayo 30% (prediction only, not guaranteed).
